text: Quick question—what's the deadline for logging on-call hours? I had an incident last night and want to make sure I report it correctly.

Hey Linda, you need to log all on-call hours and incidents in the IncidentTracker portal by 10am the next business day. Your supervisor will review it after that. It's all in the On-Call Compensation Policy doc if you need more details!
Perfect, thanks Elena! I'll get it in before 10. Didn't realize there was a hard cutoff.
No problem! Just make sure to do it on time so Marcus (Regional Ops Director) can approve it. Let me know if you have any issues.
